ingestionTime.description: Timestamp when the source report was ingested into the system

reportName.description: Name of the source report file the record was extracted from

reportFolder.description: Source folder or path where the report file was collected

session_id.description: CADIP acquisition session identifier the quality info belongs to (from SessionId)

channel.description: Channel number the quality metrics apply to (from Channel)

acquired_tfs.description: Total number of transfer frames acquired on the channel (from AcquiredTFs)

error_tfs.description: Number of transfer frames received with errors (from ErrorTFs)

corrected_tfs.description: Number of transfer frames corrected by error correction (from CorrectedTFs)

uncorrectable_tfs.description: Number of transfer frames that could not be corrected (from UncorrectableTFs)

data_tfs.description: Number of data transfer frames acquired on the channel (from DataTFs)

error_data_tfs.description: Number of data transfer frames received with errors (from ErrorDataTFs)

corrected_data_tfs.description: Number of data transfer frames corrected by error correction (from CorrectedDataTFs)

uncorrectable_data_tfs.description: Number of data transfer frames that could not be corrected (from UncorrectableDataTFs)

delivery_start.description: Start time of the delivery of the channel data (from DeliveryStart)

delivery_stop.description: Stop time of the delivery of the channel data (from DeliveryStop)

total_chunks.description: Total number of data chunks delivered for the channel (from TotalChunks)

total_volume.description: Total data volume delivered for the channel in bytes (from TotalVolume)

interface_name.description: Name of the collector interface that produced this record

production_service_type.description: Type of the production service that provided the quality info, set to CADIP

production_service_name.description: Name of the CADIP ground station service that provided the quality info
